darwin.notes: macOS 1.2.5 build 136: adds three Loop Tools in each Live Preview with independent playback, upper/lower controls, and easier moving and resizing. REC can record the app's playback mix to WAV. Instructions text can be selected and copied, and the complete guide can be exported as a printable PDF. Portable library indexes now sync incrementally; per-library full-scan time tracks active indexing and audio analysis. Includes preview, pitch and selection fixes.

win32.notes: Windows 1.2.5 build 371: adds three Loop Tools in each Live Preview with independent playback, upper/lower controls, and Ctrl+Shift+L to toggle the active set. Loop regions can be moved and resized with edge scrolling and a grip for narrow regions. Ctrl-drag can stretch an eligible Loop Tool fragment. Left/Right seek through long streamed audio without stopping playback. Instructions text can be selected and copied with Ctrl+C or the context menu; Export PDF saves the complete guide and shortcuts as a print-friendly A4 document. Includes pitch and selection fixes.
